verdict_basis: All 40 values within 0.4 px (removal) / 0.8 px (Cu). Flag: the cycle-15 removal point is genuinely below the minimum stated in the text.
independence: Verifier extracted the embedded raster itself (pymupdf, native resolution), located the ticks with its own code and re-read every value with its own scripts; extractor scripts and readings were not used.

fixes_applied.change: No change. The verifier's issue (cycle 15 plotted below the text's 96.6 % minimum; cite the figure value) is already noted in meta.json 'checks'.

max_deviation.units: left 0-100 % (0.314 per px); right 0-3 mg/L (0.0093 per px)

checks.name: axis_calibration
checks.detail: Left (red) axis majors at rows 590.0,654.0,717.5,781.0,844.93,908.0 (100..0 %), residual 0.09 %; right (blue) axis majors at 574.5,682.0,789.94,897.06 (3..0 mg/L; its zero sits ~11 px above the frame bottom, as the extractor noted), residual 0.003; cycle axis majors at x 1518,1641,1764,1887,2010 (0..20). Top axis: 0-1000 mL with 250 at cycle 5, i.e. 50 mL per cycle.

checks.name: markers
checks.detail: Red circles and blue triangles segmented by colour with a 5x5 opening; 20 of each found at cycles 1.00-20.01. Centroid and bounding-box centre agree within 0.07 % / 0.006 mg/L. Cu values at or below 0 (-0.007..-0.004) are zero.

checks.name: out_of_range_cycle15
checks.detail: Text: NO3- removal 96.6-99.9 % over 20 cycles. Cycle 15 marker centroid is at row 602.8, 1.8 px below the cycle 9 and 11 markers (601.0, 601.1), which read 96.60 and 96.58 = the text minimum. Verifier reads cycle 15 as 96.05 % (bbox 95.98), stored 96.164. The figure plots this point ~0.5 % below the text minimum; not a digitization error. Value kept.

checks.name: text_cross_check
checks.detail: Cu < 0.1 mg/L from cycle 14 on (stored max 0.097 at cycle 16); high Cu in the first four cycles (1.3-2.4 mg/L) as described. Caption: 25 mM NO3-, pH ~7, 10 mM Cl-, -2 V vs SCE, 2.0 h per cycle, matching meta.

checks.name: overlay
checks.detail: Stored values drawn as crosses on every marker, with the text minimum 96.6 % drawn as a line.

issues: Cycle 15 (96.2 %) lies below the text range 96.6-99.9 % because the figure shows it there; downstream users should cite the figure value and note the text/figure mismatch.
